newsitem.title: USA: DH says gov't extends Axiohm waiting.
newsitem.headline: DH says gov't extends Axiohm waiting.

text.p: DH Technology Inc said Friday the U.S. Department of Justice extended the waiting period concerning the tender offer by Axiohm SA for shares of the company and requested additional information.
DH did not say why the additional information was requested and was not immediately available for comment.
It said the companies will cooperate with the antitrust division of the department to end the waiting period as quickly as possible.
They said they do not expect this action will delay the completion of the tender offer.
Axiohm, a private French company, announced in July it would buy between 6.5 and 7.0 million shares of DH at $25 each.
